about: What Open Screenshot Generator's SEO view reads from this repository. The app downloads these files when the view opens (pinned to a commit, each checked against its git hash) and sends them to the user's AI as background knowledge. Paths are from the repository root.

fix-plan.about: Turn the site check's findings into a short, ordered plan.

ai-search.about: Explain what AI search tools and agents can read, and draft llms.txt.

copy.about: Rewrite page titles, descriptions and copy so they read as written by a person.

google.about: Read Search Console, Analytics, PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals numbers.

ask.about: Answer the user's own questions about their site.
